articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 500K Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic officially launched Claude 4, its most capable model to date, featuring a 500,000-token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates near-human performance on several graduate-level benchmark tests and introduces a new 'deep reflection' mode for complex problem solving. The release marks a major escalation in the ongoing competition with OpenAI and Google.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaCode 3 Achieves Expert-Level Performance on Real-World Software Engineering Tasks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind published research showing AlphaCode 3 can autonomously complete complex, multi-file software engineering tasks at the level of a senior developer with 5+ years of experience. The system was evaluated on a new benchmark involving real GitHub repositories rather than isolated coding puzzles. Researchers note the model still struggles with ambiguous requirements but handles well-specified tasks with remarkable precision.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflow Automation
articles.summary: OpenAI unveiled a new enterprise-focused agent platform built on GPT-5, allowing businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents that can manage emails, coordinate calendars, and execute multi-step workflows across third-party tools. The platform includes a new permission and audit layer designed to address corporate governance concerns. Early customers include several Fortune 500 companies who participated in a closed beta since January.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines for Non-Compliant LLM Deployments
articles.summary: The newly established EU AI Office handed down its first significant fines totaling €47 million against two European tech firms for deploying large language models in high-risk categories without proper documentation and human oversight mechanisms. The enforcement action signals a new era of regulatory seriousness following years of preparation since the Act's passage. Legal experts say the rulings will force a broad reassessment of AI deployment practices across the continent.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout in Open-Source, Claiming Best-in-Class Multimodal Performance
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a multimodal model capable of processing text, images, audio, and video in a single unified architecture, making it freely available for research and commercial use. Internal benchmarks show Scout outperforming GPT-4o on several vision-language tasks while running efficiently on consumer-grade hardware with 24GB VRAM. The release has already generated significant excitement in the open-source AI community.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Powered 'Copilot Deep Search' Across All Office 365 Products
articles.summary: Microsoft announced a sweeping update to its Copilot suite that brings retrieval-augmented generation capabilities to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, allowing the AI to pull in real-time data from connected SharePoint, OneDrive, and external web sources mid-conversation. The new feature, called Copilot Deep Search, is designed to dramatically reduce AI hallucinations in enterprise document workflows. The rollout begins this week for business subscribers.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Enabled Disinformation Ahead of 2026 Midterms
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released an urgent policy brief documenting a threefold increase in AI-generated political disinformation compared to the same period before the 2024 elections. The report highlights the proliferation of hyper-personalized synthetic video and audio content designed to micro-target voters on social media platforms. Researchers are calling on Congress to pass emergency disclosure legislation before the November midterm elections.

articles.title: Mistral AI Launches 'Le Chat Pro' With Real-Time Web Browsing and Code Execution
articles.summary: French AI startup Mistral AI upgraded its consumer assistant Le Chat to a Pro tier featuring live web search, Python code execution, and document analysis powered by its latest Mistral Large 3 model. The launch positions Mistral as a serious European competitor to ChatGPT Plus and Gemini Advanced, with pricing set at €15 per month. The company emphasized GDPR-native data handling as a key differentiator for privacy-conscious European users.
